newsitem.title: USA: Ford sees record Q2 profits - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ford sees record Q2 profits - WSJ.

text.p: Ford Motor Co is expected to post record quarterly profits, according to the Wall Street Journal.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said the auto company is expected to earn more than the $1.9 billion, or $1.56 per share, that it reported for last year's second quarter.
The newspaper attributed the historic levels to Wall Street analysts and unnamed sources close to the company.
The Journal also reported that Ford is expected to announce plans to increase its production of trucks.
Ford executives began signalling the company's improved second-quarter projections to analysts at a recent meeting, prompting nine analysts to raise their earnings expecations.
The consensus estimate among 18 analysts is earnings of $1.69 per share for the second quarter, up from $1.57 per share.
Ford's chief investor-relations spokesman, Mel Stephens, told the Journal the company was comfortable with the latest analysts' estimates.
"We're clearly headed in the right direction, but we still have a lot of work to do," Stephens said.
